definition.en: The capability of closing a garment with hook-and-loop tape: two facing strips, one hooked and one looped, that grip anywhere along their overlap. Unlike a hook set, it has no discrete positions — the adjustment is continuous — and unlike a zip it can be opened anywhere along its length at once.
definition.es: La capacidad de cerrar una prenda con cinta de gancho y bucle: dos tiras enfrentadas, una de ganchos y otra de bucles, que agarran en cualquier punto de su solape. A diferencia de un juego de corchetes, no tiene posiciones discretas —el ajuste es continuo— y a diferencia de una cremallera puede abrirse de una vez en toda su longitud.
definition.fr: La capacité de fermer un vêtement avec une bande auto-agrippante : deux bandes en vis-à-vis, l'une à crochets et l'autre à boucles, qui accrochent en tout point de leur recouvrement. Contrairement à un jeu d'agrafes, elle n'a pas de positions discrètes — le réglage est continu — et contrairement à une glissière elle s'ouvre d'un coup sur toute sa longueur.
definition.pt: A capacidade de fechar uma peça com fita de gancho e argola: duas tiras frente a frente, uma de ganchos e outra de argolas, que agarram em qualquer ponto da sua sobreposição. Ao contrário de um jogo de colchetes, não tem posições discretas — o ajuste é contínuo — e ao contrário de um fecho de correr pode abrir-se de uma vez em todo o comprimento.

aliases.name: hook_loop_closure
aliases.note: hyperobject.capabilities key; one cartridge (hi-vis-vest) as of 2026-09-02, bridging to yantra4d/hook-loop-tape.

constraints: The overlap is the adjustment range, so it is drafted from how much the closure must give and not from how much cloth is spare — and the two strips must be long enough that the closure still holds at its loosest legitimate setting.
notes: Named nearly like `hook_closure` and not the same capability: that one is hook-and-EYE, this is hook-and-LOOP. The catalog evidence separates them cleanly — the bras bridge to yantra4d/hook-and-eye, the hi-vis vest to yantra4d/hook-loop-tape — and the capability vocabulary records the pair as distinct so an automated de-duplication cannot merge them.
